audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Timothy text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for prayer for all, one mediator, modesty, women learning/teaching passage, Adam/Eve argument. Requires second-pass source, syntax, and reception-history audit.

verses.restored: First of all, then, I appeal that petitions, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings be made for all humans,

familiar.text: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

modern.text: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—

original.text: Παρακαλῶ οὖν πρῶτον πάντων ποιεῖσθαι δεήσεις, προσευχάς, ἐντεύξεις, εὐχαριστίας, ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων,

verses.restored: for kings and all those being in high position, so that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all reverence and dignity.

familiar.text: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

modern.text: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.

original.text: ὑπὲρ βασιλέων καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐν ὑπεροχῇ ὄντων, ἵνα ἤρεμον καὶ ἡσύχιον βίον διάγωμεν ἐν πάσῃ εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ σεμνότητι.

verses.restored: This is beautiful/good and acceptable before Divine our Savior/Healer,

familiar.text: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

modern.text: This is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,

original.text: ⸀τοῦτο καλὸν καὶ ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,

verses.restored: who wills all humans to be saved/healed and to come into knowledge of truth.

familiar.text: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

modern.text: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

original.text: ὃς πάντας ἀνθρώπους θέλει σωθῆναι καὶ εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν.

verses.restored: For there is one Divine and one mediator of Divine and humans, human Messiah Jesus,

familiar.text: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

modern.text: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

original.text: εἷς γὰρ θεός, εἷς καὶ μεσίτης θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων ἄνθρωπος Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς,

verses.restored: the One giving himself as ransom/release-price for all, the witness in its own seasons.

familiar.text: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

modern.text: who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.

original.text: ὁ δοὺς ἑαυτὸν ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων, τὸ μαρτύριον καιροῖς ἰδίοις·

verses.restored: Into this I was appointed herald and apostle, I speak truth, I do not lie, teacher of nations in trust and truth.

familiar.text: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

modern.text: For this reason I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles. I am telling the truth; I am not lying about anything.

original.text: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος— ἀλήθειαν ⸀λέγω, οὐ ψεύδομαι— διδάσκαλος ἐθνῶν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.

verses.restored: Therefore I desire the men in every place to pray, lifting holy hands without anger and argument.

familiar.text: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

modern.text: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension. Instructions to Women

original.text: Βούλομαι οὖν προσεύχεσθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ, ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ ⸀διαλογισμοῦ.

verses.restored: Likewise also women, in respectable arrangement, with modesty and soundness of mind, to adorn themselves not with braided hair and gold or pearls or costly clothing,

familiar.text: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

modern.text: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,

original.text: ὡσαύτως ⸀καὶ γυναῖκας ἐν καταστολῇ κοσμίῳ μετὰ αἰδοῦς καὶ σωφροσύνης κοσμεῖν ἑαυτάς, μὴ ἐν πλέγμασιν ⸀καὶ ⸀χρυσίῳ ἢ μαργαρίταις ἢ ἱματισμῷ πολυτελεῖ,

verses.restored: but with what is fitting for women professing reverence for the Divine: through good works.

familiar.text: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

modern.text: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.

original.text: ἀλλʼ ὃ πρέπει γυναιξὶν ἐπαγγελλομέναις θεοσέβειαν, διʼ ἔργων ἀγαθῶν.

verses.restored: Let a woman learn in quietness, in all teachability/orderly submission.

familiar.text: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

modern.text: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.

original.text: γυνὴ ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ μανθανέτω ἐν πάσῃ ὑποταγῇ·

verses.restored: But I do not permit a woman to teach or to domineer over a man, but to be in quietness.

familiar.text: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

modern.text: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.

original.text: ⸂διδάσκειν δὲ γυναικὶ⸃ οὐκ ἐπιτρέπω, οὐδὲ αὐθεντεῖν ἀνδρός, ἀλλʼ εἶναι ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ.

verses.restored: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

familiar.text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

modern.text: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.

original.text: Ἀδὰμ γὰρ πρῶτος ἐπλάσθη, εἶτα Εὕα·

verses.restored: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been deceived, has come into transgression.

familiar.text: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

modern.text: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.

original.text: καὶ Ἀδὰμ οὐκ ἠπατήθη, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ⸀ἐξαπατηθεῖσα ἐν παραβάσει γέγονεν.

verses.restored: But she will be saved/healed through the childbearing, if they remain in trust and love and holiness with soundness of mind.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

modern.text: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.

original.text: σωθήσεται δὲ διὰ τῆς τεκνογονίας, ἐὰν μείνωσιν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ καὶ ἁγιασμῷ μετὰ σωφροσύνης.

safety_note: 1 Timothy 2:11-15 is variant-sensitive in interpretation and highly dangerous in reception history. The draft preserves the text while noting that authentein is rare and can mean domineer/usurp rather than ordinary teaching authority. This passage must not be used to silence women broadly without second-pass Greek syntax, historical-context, and reception-history audit, especially because women pray/prophesy and serve as coworkers elsewhere in the Pauline corpus.
